title: Possible SQL injection in search parameter q
description: ZAP alerts that appending a single quote to the q parameter returned a 500 Internal Server Error on /search. A boolean differential test may confirm boolean-based injectable parameter. Safe non-destructive probes only.

evidence.excerpt: XSS to SQL error report: appending ") OR 1=1--" resulted in a 500 with an internal error trace mentioning SequelizeDatabaseError
Response length variation when a single quote is appended to q (2814 vs 1200 bytes).
